disclosure: The nine baseline signed-bin pPXF values and their side-consistency checks were known. No completed bootstrap covariance, bootstrap-half diagnostic, systematic-grid fit, final covariance, or five-bin GLS profile had been inspected.

assembly.parameter_order: velocity signed bins 1..9 followed by dispersion signed bins 1..9
assembly.bootstrap_covariance: Unbiased joint sample covariance of the complete nine-bin velocity and dispersion bootstrap vectors.
assembly.systematic_covariance: Uncentered second moment about the frozen baseline: mean over all 27 complete grid runs of delta times delta-transpose. The exact baseline run remains in the ensemble with zero delta.
assembly.total_covariance: bootstrap covariance plus systematic covariance; do not add pPXF formal variances again because the joint wild/exposure bootstrap already propagates measurement noise.
assembly.bootstrap_halves: Split by requested replicate number 1-100 versus 101-200. For every signed dispersion bin compare each half-covariance diagonal and standard error to the full-bootstrap counterpart.
assembly.covariance_diagonal_fractional_change: absolute difference between half diagonals divided by the full-bootstrap diagonal; take the maximum over both halves and all nine bins.
assembly.sigma_error_fractional_change: absolute difference between each half standard error and the full-bootstrap standard error divided by the full-bootstrap standard error; take the maximum over both halves and all nine bins.
assembly.symmetrization: For velocity and dispersion separately, retain signed bin 5 as the central radial bin. For pairs (4,6), (3,7), (2,8), and (1,9), use inverse-2x2-covariance weights normalized to sum to one. Apply the resulting fixed 5x9 matrices to the full joint 18x18 covariance so cross-parameter and cross-radius covariance is retained.
assembly.realized_lens_overlap: Recount distinct independently redshift-anchored image radii at or inside the outer edge of the outermost finite radial bin.
